description: logserver per-revision log directories across update and rollback, the update output, and rotation/cleanup under a small PV_LOG_DIR_MAXSIZE

config.env: PV_CONTROL_REMOTE=0 PV_SECUREBOOT_MODE=disabled PV_LOG_LEVEL=5 PV_LOG_SERVER_OUTPUTS=filetree PV_LOG_DIR_MAXSIZE=2MB PV_LOG_ROTATE_FACTOR=4 PV_LOG_HYSTERESIS_FACTOR=4
